title: Ai algo scalping
author: Time-Second-7639
selftext:
I want to make ai find me algos to scalp with and im wandering if someone done that and succeeded. 

The whole idea is to run a bot that tries and checks lots of ideas untill he finds few profitable ones than paper trade them and if they are solid real bot trade with them focusing on 5m/15m timeframes and i want to try gold cfds or futures with high leverage

comments.author: CommandantZ
comments.body:
Professional bot developer here,

That's not how AI trading works at all unfortunately.

Feel free to check out my last post, I've spoken a bit about trading Gold CFDs with trading bots. Some might work sure, but surely not what you described!
